## What changes?

Describe the result for someone using the reference. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Evidence and orientation

For a mapping change, identify the connectors/pads, current and proposed assignments, source or measurement, and physical viewing convention. Distinguish observations from interpretations.

## Checks and related files

Describe what you checked. Identify affected CSV, workbook, symbol, schematic and diagram copies; flag any that still need updating. Preserve source credits and add user-visible mapping changes to CHANGELOG.md.
